objective: Five laws that make one birth at a time and differ in how far a knot reads and when it may read (the present roster; own parents; partners parents too; the whole set of knots made with it; the present part), with the depth guard of the record as control, compared with the complete rounds in every order on registered starts under laws with a ration fixed at birth, with waiting, and under ordinary growth. First discriminator: every order on the cycle of four through dead knots with waiting. Stop when every frozen prediction has a verdict.
title: One birth at a time from what is built: five laws against the complete rounds, in every order
